text:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Anomalous outputs detected during rollout of model 'redwood-llm/v2' — canary shards returning garbled tokens and increased 5xxs. Canary ID: canary-47. Root cause unknown, paging on-call.
ryan_oncall: On it, paging SRE and Eng-ML. Marking this P1 and starting handoff.
ops-bot: Paging sent to @ryan_oncall, @julia_sre, @mike_infra. Incident channel created: #inc-8265432100.
julia_sre: Seeing tokenizer mismatch in logs: token id mapping out of range and frequent \"unknown token\" emissions. Sample log: ```[2026-03-17T10:15:40Z] model:redwood-llm/v2 shard:3 warn: tokenizer.map failed id=99812 -> <UNK>```
mike_infra: Canary config shows weightset tag = "v2-fp16-annotated" but the artifact manifest lists quantized format q4_0. Kernel selection likely using wrong layout.
eng-ml-lead: Confirmed — weightset metadata incorrectly labeled during promotion. Some shards loaded with mismatched tokenizer bundle. Preparing a rollback plan.
sara_ops: Immediate mitigation: flipping feature flag to stop rollout traffic. Executing: ```curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' https://internal.flags/api/set -d '{"flag":"model.rollout.allow","value":false}'```
ryan_oncall: Flag flipped to false, verifying traffic routing. Initiating rollback to stable alias 'redwood-llm@stable-202602'.
mike_infra: Rolling back with rbctl: ```rbctl deploy rollback --alias redwood-llm@stable-202602 --target canary-47 --dry-run=false``` Starting traffic cutover.
csm_ana: Notifying impacted customers: ticket created INC-2026-331. Initial estimate: 3 customers observed degraded outputs, 1 reported API 500s. CS will send templated update in 15 mins.
julia_sre: After rollback start, tokenization errors dropped on 2/3 canary hosts. Continuing to drain remaining canary-47 nodes.
eng-ml-lead: Root cause summary for postmortem: misannotated artifact metadata — weightset artifact uploaded with incorrect runtime tag, plus a packaging bug that decoupled tokenizer bundle from weightset during promotion.
sara_ops: Added temporary safeguard: validation step to verify artifact.format == tokenizer.format before promotion. Filing PR to CI: https://git.internal/redwood/ci/pull/4872
ryan_oncall: Cutover complete. Traffic back to stable alias. Monitoring metrics: token error rate back to baseline (0.02%), 5xx reduced. Closing live mitigation.
deploy-bot: Canary drains complete. Incident severity lowered to P2. Please continue with post-incident review in #postmortems and attach logs/artifacts. :white_check_mark:
mike_infra: Follow-ups: retract faulty artifact tags, add pre-promotion checksum check, and run canary with tokenizer bundle binding in staging. I'll own the rollout hardening tickets.
csm_ana: CS update sent to affected customers; will follow-up with personalized remediation notes.
eng-ml-lead: ETA for full fix and re-rollout: 48h. Will coordinate a controlled redeploy with explicit artifact-validation gates.
ryan_oncall: Thanks team. If anything regresses, re-open channel or page immediately. :thumbsup:
